verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform that ships AI agents for screening, transaction monitoring and alert remediation, so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data is excluded from model training. The axis therefore applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage control or any training-data policy. The nearest items (monitor/unmonitor settings, exports, webhook signing) are different controls and earn no credit.
